jobs.title: Analyste Financier
jobs.description_text:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Lyft recherche un analyste financier pour rejoindre son équipe FP&A (Planification et Analyse Financières) au sein de Lyft Urban Solutions (vélos en libre-service et micromobilité). Ce poste est axé sur la planification financière, la modélisation des réponses aux appels d'offres et l'analyse stratégique. Le candidat idéal possédera une solide expertise en modélisation financière, un grand souci du détail, un esprit d'initiative et une capacité à évoluer efficacement dans un contexte d'incertitude. Doté d'une mentalité d'amélioration continue, il contribuera à la prise de décisions stratégiques chez Lyft. At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We're hiring a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team at a pivotal moment — we're actively integrating recent acquisitions, implementing a new Treasury Management System, and scaling our banking infrastructure across a rapidly growing international footprint supporting Lyft’s core, autonomous, and luxury offerings. This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one.

Reporting to the Head of Treasury, you'll support critical functional areas and workstreams including cash management, liquidity optimization, and SOX compliance, while getting exposure to strategic projects that shape how Treasury operates across the company. If you're intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and energized by a fast-moving environment, you'll thrive here.

jobs.title: UX Research Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is seeking a Mixed Methods User Experience Research Intern to join our team, which aspires to elevate the user experience for our drivers and riders across 300+ cities nationwide. You will conduct research studies, as well as participate in studies alongside more senior researchers from which you’ll gain strong mentorship. You will partner with Design, Product Management, Analytics, and Engineering in order to derive deep insights about our users’ behaviors and attitudes, and communicate results and actionable recommendations across the company.

Interns contribute to user-facing products, working side-by-side with top User Experience Research team members in the industry while having autonomy from the get-go. Lyft fosters a collaborative environment in the office, so there's always a sharp mind eager to hear about your next idea. So what's yours?

Responsibilities:

  • Design and conduct studies across key Lyft product areas -- independently and in conjunction with more senior researchers. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description_text: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset.
